# Repo Facts

- 2026-10-21 **added (git 檢查點：SOEM 本地修補持久化 + 補 `.gitmodules` + DSH 加入維護)**: 2026-09-06 之後的全部未提交變更（Web i18n、ShutdownGuard、GuardedString＋UI 限時訊息、ForceWin10Mode、CpuTopology、`pdoExchangeCS` 拆鎖、viewer 旋翼動畫、scripts/docs 重整）以單一檢查點 commit 入檔。
  **發現的遺失風險**：`lib/SOEM` 是指向上游 `OpenEtherCATsociety/SOEM` `a7c74ce` 的 gitlink，五個本地修補檔（`src/ec_main.c`、`src/ec_coe.c` NULL guard、`osal/win32/osal_defs.h`、`oshw/win32/nicdrv.c/.h`）在 submodule 內**未提交**，且 repo 沒有 `.gitmodules`（`git submodule status` 報 fatal）→ 新環境既拿不到 patch 也無法初始化。
  **處置**：修補以 `git -C lib/SOEM diff HEAD --output=<絕對路徑>` 匯出為 **`lib/SOEM-local-changes.patch`** 隨主 repo 提交；新建 `.gitmodules`（url＝submodule 現有 origin＝上游），gitlink 維持上游 SHA，新環境 `git submodule update --init` 後 `git -C lib/SOEM apply ../SOEM-local-changes.patch` 還原。`.gitignore` 新增 `tools/cdb/sym/`（cdb 執行期符號快取；`tools/cdb` 的 exe/dll 依既有 `*.exe/*.dll` 規則不入檔＝機器安裝件，見 2026-06-12 條目）。
  **規則**：改 lib/SOEM 原始碼後必須同一 patch 重新匯出 patch 檔（AGENTS.md 已同步）。`lib/SOEM` 屬其他 SID 擁有的 checkout，Administrator 執行 git 需 `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory/GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0` 環境變數（`-c safe.directory=...` 無效）。⚠️ `Par/license.txt`（64 hex 授權金鑰）**不入版控**（已加 `.gitignore`；本檢查點已 amend 移出，origin/main 的 `Par/` 向來無金鑰＝遠端從未出現）。**授權金鑰 upstream 政策（2026-10-21 使用者定案）**：origin（`github.com/wuyenhung/BigCat`，舊名 WuSOEM_C-- 為 redirect）是**公開** repo，clone 者無金鑰、只能以**試用版**執行；`LicenseChecker`／TPM 執行檢查與 `tools/generate_license` 原始碼照舊在版控內維護，不得放寬或繞過。CMake `copy_directory`（`CMakeLists.txt` L683-689）整目錄複製 Par/，缺金鑰不影響 clone 與建置。
  同日 **DSH（DeepSeek Harness）** 成為與 Copilot、Claude Code 並列的第三個維護入口：讀取同一套 AGENTS.md／CLAUDE.md／repo-facts.md（無平行記憶），私有檔案僅專案根 `local-model-stats.json`（派工帳單＋lessons）。
  Validation: patch 檔 15,664 bytes、`git -C lib/SOEM apply --reverse --check` exit 0（證明與現行 worktree 完全一致）；amend 後 `git ls-tree HEAD Par/` 不含 `license.txt`（`git check-ignore` 命中），`git show --stat` 含 locales/、i18n.js、`lib/SOEM-local-changes.patch`、`.gitmodules`。尚**未**做 fresh-clone 端到端（submodule init＋apply patch 流程於下次換機器時實測）。

- 2026-10-21 **added (Web UI 多語系：繁中／英文即時切換，可擴充語系；純前端，未動 C++)**: 新增 `resources/web/js/i18n.js`，採「**中文原文作 key**」的來源字串目錄翻譯全站：掃描 text node 與 `title`/`placeholder`/`aria-label`/`alt` 屬性、`document.title`、`<html lang>`，`MutationObserver` 自動覆蓋 JS 動態內容與 `innerHTML` 插入節點；目錄 key 含 `*` 即 wildcard pattern（供 JS 串接／樣板字串），比對時正規化空白；另包裝 `alert/confirm/prompt` 與 canvas `fillText/strokeText`。跳過 `<script>/<style>/<textarea>/<pre>`（`status.html` 的後端 log 是一整塊 text node，不做逐字翻譯）與標了 `data-i18n-skip` 的子樹。來源語系 `zh-Hant` 時引擎完全 no-op（目錄空、不寫 DOM）；缺譯退回原文，不會破功能。
  語系選擇順序：`?lang=` → `localStorage.wusoem_locale_v1` → `navigator.languages`（取第一個能對應到內建語系的偏好；若該偏好就是來源語系則維持原文，不會退到第二偏好 en）→ `zh-Hant`。`I18N.setLocale()` 即時切換（先把上一語系改過的節點還原成原文再重掃），並發出 `wusoem-i18n-change` 事件。
  檔案：`resources/web/locales/index.json`（語系註冊表；新增語系＝放一個 `<code>.json` ＋ 此檔加一行，HTML/JS/C++ 都不用改）、`locales/zh-Hant.json`（來源語系，messages 預設留空）、`locales/en.json`（819 條＝exact＋pattern，人工維護的資產）；7 個頁面 `<head>` 在 viewport meta 之後、其他 script 之前載入 `js/i18n.js`；`sidebar-menu.js` 在登入鈕下方產生 `.lang-switcher`（按鈕依註冊表順序、顯示各語系 `nativeName`、整列 `data-i18n-skip` 不翻譯語言名稱、`data-login-exempt` 讓未登入也能切換、等 `I18N.ready()` 後才建立以避免註冊表非同步載入時清單是空的），`sidebar-menu.css` 加對應樣式。`sidebar-menu.js` 另修一處 locale 敏感邏輯：側選單項目去重原本只比 `textContent`（切英文後比不中會重複插入），改為同時比對原文與譯文。
  工具／文件：`scripts/i18n_report.ps1`（覆蓋率報告：抽出原文 key→比對各語系目錄，`-Detailed` 附來源、`-OutFile` 另存、`-FailOnMissing` 缺譯即 exit 1 可接 CI）、`docs/WEB_I18N.md`（機制、新增語系步驟、維護要點與陷阱）、`scripts/README.md`、`AGENTS.md` 專案概述／目錄表。
  **踩過的地雷（日後改動必讀）**：(1) 正則字元類別**直接放字面字元範圍**時，`[豈-﫿]`（U+8C48–U+FAFF，起點落在 CJK 主區塊內）會把 surrogate 也判為符合，`🏠`（D83C DFE0）被誤認為含中文 → 範圍一律寫 `\uXXXX` 轉義且區段用區塊真正起點（`\u4e00`、`\uf900`）。(2) 引擎寫 `nodeValue`／`setAttribute` 會再次觸發 observer，須用 `pendingWrite` 預期值比對跳過自己寫的記錄，否則無限迴圈。(3) 目錄 key 必須等於**執行期**文字：markup 來源要解碼 `&amp;`/`&copy;`、JS 來源要把 `\\` 還原成 `\`，否則永不命中。(4) 用 DOM 顯示文字做邏輯判斷的程式碼在翻譯後會失效（本 repo 僅 sidebar 去重一處已修；`stewart_platform.html` 的 `riskLevel === '低'` 是 JS 內部值，安全）。(5) 靜態檔帶 `Cache-Control: max-age=300`，改完目錄/引擎要 Ctrl+F5 或加 `&v=<timestamp>`。
  **同日後續（使用者回報「自動畫面英文導致按鈕與版面跑掉」）**：根因不是英文字長本身，而是 `grid-template-columns: 1fr` 的 `1fr` 下限＝**min-content**；中文可按字元斷行（min-content 只一個字），英文以單字為單位（`Immediate`、`messages`）→ 欄位被撐大、按鈕推出容器（`auto.html` 1280px 時 `container` 626>600、480px 時整頁橫向滾動）。修法＝柵欄改 `repeat(N, minmax(0, 1fr))`、文字容器補 `min-width: 0` + `overflow-wrap: anywhere`、`auto.html` 手機版按鈕字級 `clamp(20px,6.5vw,32px)`→`clamp(17px,5.2vw,26px)`（避免英文單字斷中間、按鈕高低不一）、表頭 `th` 改可換行（數值 `td` 仍單行＋省略號）、`stewart_platform.html` 的 `.grid-cols-*`/`.main-grid`/`.result-grid`/`.native-planner-pose-row` 全部 `1fr`→`minmax(0,1fr)` 並讓 `.viz-header` 可 wrap、`viewer_6dof.css` 兩欄同樣處理。**慣例**：往後寫柵欄一律 `minmax(0, 1fr)`，改文案/樣式後要 zh 與 en **並排量測**每個含文字節點的 `scrollWidth>clientWidth`（截字）與「右緣超出父容器」（擠出），只有「英文才有、中文沒有」才算 i18n 回歸（`stewart_platform.html` 兩個 checkbox label 的 6px 裁切中文模式也有＝既有版面）。
  **同日後續（燈號標籤）**：`auto.html` 6 個 `.lamp` 與 `help.html` 燈號表原本寫死 `oEtherCatOk/oBusy/oError/oReady/oHomeDone/oOnline`——純拉丁字串引擎不翻譯，中文模式也是英文；改為中文原文（EtherCAT 正常／忙碌／錯誤／就緒／原點完成／上線），`en.json` 新增 6 條（EtherCAT OK／Busy／Error／Ready／Home done／Online，**去掉 `o` 前綴**），`help.html` 用 `<span>` 包住標籤讓 key 保持乾淨。**規則**：UI 顯示文字一律以中文原文書寫，純英文標籤永遠不會被翻譯。
  **同日後續（狀態訊息頁 `status.html` 改暗黑底色佈局）**：它是站內唯一的白底頁（`body #fff/#333`、`pre #f4f4f4/#ddd`、共享 `.status-header #333`），
  已改吃 `shared-variables.css` 的 `--bg-color`／`--panel-bg`／`--text-color`／`--border-color`（與 `auto.html`、側選單、`auth.js` 登入框同一套深色系）；
  按鈕改深灰漸層＋`--border-color` 圓角（附 hover/disabled）、checkbox 用 `accent-color: var(--accent)`、log 區塊改 `--panel-bg`＋圓角 6px＋`#e6e6e6` 文字、
  捲軸與 `::selection` 一併轉深色；`sidebar-menu.css` 的 `.status-header` 顏色由寫死 `#333` 改 `var(--text-color)`（此 class 僅 status.html 使用）。
  WCAG 對比用 JS 實算（含 rgba 合成）：頁面/標題/label 文字 15.91:1、log 文字 11.03:1、按鈕文字對漸層亮端 10.53:1、toast 白字對綠底 6.97:1、對紅底 7.69:1，全過 AA 4.5。

- 2026-10-03 **added (強制使用 Windows 10 執行方式：[Compat] ForceWin10Mode，預設停用)**: `BigCat.ini` 新增 `[Compat] ForceWin10Mode`（`0` = 依作業系統自動判斷（**預設＝停用強制**）；`1` = 即使在 Win11 也強制採用 Win10 週期等待策略：HR waitable timer + 200µs TSC margin，等效於所有 `!g_isWin11` 分支成立；用途為釐清平台差異或作為 Win11 waitable-timer 修復後的回退開關）。
  實作：`AppConfig::ReadForceWin10Compat()`（`include/core/AppConfig.h`、`src/core/AppConfig.cpp`；`EnsureDefaultIniFile()` 缺鍵時寫入 `0`）；`EtherCATMaster.Cyclic.cpp::DetectOSVersion()` 偵測後若開關為 1 即 `g_isWin11=false` 並記下 `g_win10CompatForced`（於 CyclicTask 啟動時讀取一次，位置在 PDO 週期迴圈之前，不在即時路徑），該處另以 `SetError("Compat: [Compat] ForceWin10Mode=1 …")` 於連線時輸出確認；`src/app/main.cpp` 啟動時把「已啟用/停用」寫入狀態列（**不需連線**即可確認）。`tests/test_Ethercat_jog.cpp::cycle_timer::init()` 讀取同一份 `BigCat.ini` 的同鍵值（自行解析，未新增 link 依賴）並在 `[OS] detected …` 診斷列標示 `forced`，保持工具與主程式一致。
  文件：`Par/BigCat.ini`、`Par/BigCatLu.ini` 新增 `[Compat]` 區段（繁中註解、值 `0`）、`docs/WIN11_KNOWN_ISSUES.md` §3 新增「手動強制切換」段落、`docs/windows-realtime-optimization.md` 模組對照表、`README_TW.md`／`README_EN.md` 常用 INI 鍵清單。
  Validation: Build: Incremental Crash 成功（0 errors）；smoke 26/27（唯一失敗為既有 flakiness `test_simulation_filter_velocity_stability`）。實機驗證（全程 `AutoTrigger=0`，只啟動→檢查→結束，不連線、不碰硬體）：(1) `ForceWin10Mode=1` → status.log 出現 `[Compat] 強制使用 Windows 10 執行方式：已啟用（[Compat] ForceWin10Mode=1；週期等待改用 Win10 策略）`；(2) 把 `[Compat]` 區段整個刪除後啟動 → `EnsureDefaultIniFile()` 自動補回 `ForceWin10Mode=0`，且 status.log 顯示「停用（…依作業系統自動判斷）」→ 證實**預設＝停用**。另搭配安全版模擬連線（web `POST /set_adapter=__SIM_ECAT6__` → `/ui_state` 安全閘確認 → `POST /connect`）確認此建置在啟用狀態下仍可正常啟動與模擬連線；注意此開關只影響實體連線的 `CyclicTask` 等待策略，**模擬路徑不經過 `DetectOSVersion()`**，因此模擬連線不會出現上面的 `Compat:` 連線訊息。

- AI 修改風格：修改期間極簡輸出（批次編輯用「`✎ 編輯 N 個檔案...`」、單一編輯用「`✎ <檔名>...`」），不展開 diff、不逐行解釋；完成後才總結（檔案清單 + 每檔一句話關鍵變更 + 是否行為變更）。

- 2026-10-03 **verified (安全相關 — 只改 INI 的 AutoSelectedAdapter 不足以保證「不連實體硬體」)**: 驗證時把執行檔旁 `BigCat.ini` 改成 `[Network] AutoSelectedAdapter=__SIM_ECAT6__`（其餘不變，`AutoTrigger` 仍為 1）後啟動，應用程式**仍在啟動期把選取改成實體 Intel I210**（`rpcap://\Device\NPF_{9E405E3A-...}`）、自動連上 6 台實體從站，並把 INI 的 `AutoSelectedAdapter` 覆寫回實體網卡。log 證據：`Selected adapter: rpcap://\Device\NPF_{9E405E3A-...}`、`All 6 slaves configured successfully`、`Cyclic operation started — all slaves in OP`、`[Connect] ALL SLAVES wrote 0x6040=0x0006 via SDO SUCCESS`（Shutdown/安全狀態，未進 Operation Enabled、未下任何運動命令）、`[AutoStartup] 連接成功，準備自動啟動程序...`（隨即在驗證腳本 kill，未執行自動程序）。
  **規則（新增，AI 與人皆適用）**：要以模擬模式做端對端驗證時，**不可只編輯 INI**；必須 (1) 先將 `[Startup] AutoTrigger=0`（避免啟動即自動連線），(2) 透過應用程式自身流程切換（web `POST /set_adapter` 或 UI 下拉選單）成 `__SIM_ECAT6__`，(3) 以 `/ui_state` 檢查 `selected_adapter == "__SIM_ECAT6__"`（或 `adapter_status` 以 `simulation:` 開頭）作為**安全閘**，通過後才 `/connect`，並在驗證後把選取切回原本的實體網卡。
  未深究啟動期覆寫的完整路徑（已知線索：`PopulateAdapters()` 之後 `PostMessageW(WM_USER_REFRESH_IRQ_DISPLAY)` → 其處理器用 `GetSelectedAdapterUtf8()` 讀回 combobox 選取 → `SetSelectedAdapter()` 會把結果寫回 INI，若此時 combobox 停在第一項（實體網卡）就會覆寫掉模擬選取）。

- 2026-10-03 **fixed (收斂同類風險：非 UI 執行緒對 UI 的阻斷式 SendMessage／UI 控制項直達)**: 承接同日 Win11 啟動死鎖，把所有「HTTP/SSE 工作執行緒直接碰 UI」的路徑一併收斂，並確立專案規則：**非 UI 執行緒不得對 UI 視窗/控制項做無上限 `SendMessage`，也不得直接操作原生控制項**。
  (1) 新增共用 helper `CoreHelpers::SendUiMessageBounded(hwnd,msg,wParam,lParam,timeoutMs=100,&timedOut)`（inline，`include/core/CoreHelpers.h`，內部用 `SendMessageTimeoutW(..., SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG|SMTO_BLOCK, 100ms)`；同執行緒呼叫時仍直接派送，故 UI 執行緒路徑行為不變，逾時回 0 由呼叫端退回快取）。
  (2) `HttpServer.API.cpp`：`/api/mmf/status` 不再 `SendMessageW(g_hwndHttpTarget, WM_USER+250)`（該訊息處理器保留但已無程式內呼叫者），改讀 `master->IsMMFOutputEnabled()`（= `mmfOutputEnabled_` 原子，與勾選框 handler `EnableMMFOutput/DisableMMFOutput` 同一來源）。
  (3) `MainWindow::SetSelectedAdapter(ifname, isWeb)` 拆成兩段：快取／INI 寫入留在原處（可在 HTTP 執行緒），原生 UI 部分（combobox `CB_*`／`EnableWindow`／RT core 與 IRQ 顯示／`ApplySystemWideIrqAffinityToCpu0` registry 工作）移入新函式 `MainWindow::ApplySelectedAdapterToNativeUi()`；`SetSelectedAdapter` 以 `IsUiThreadOwningWindow(hwnd)`（`GetWindowThreadProcessId(hwnd)==GetCurrentThreadId()`）判斷，非 UI 執行緒時只 `PostMessageW(hwnd, WM_USER_APPLY_SELECTED_ADAPTER_UI, 0, 0)`（新 ID `WM_USER+218`，`UIConstants.h`），由 WndProc 在 UI 執行緒呼叫 `ApplySelectedAdapterToNativeUi(currentIfName)`（`currentIfName` 為空則 no-op）。這同時移除了 HTTP 請求路徑上的 registry/WMI 阻塞。
  (4) `GetSelectedAdapterUtf8()`／`TryGetAdapterPcapNameFromComboSelection()`／`ApplySelectedAdapterToNativeUi()` 內的 combo 查詢全部改用 `SendUiMessageBounded`。
  已確認安全、不需修改：`src/server/MainWindow.HTTP.cpp` 的 combo helper（`ApplyHttpMmfOutputToggle`/`SelectSlaveComboIndex`/`TrySelectSlaveFromHttpValue`）只從 posted 命令管線 `HandlePostedUtf8LogMessage`（唯一呼叫點 = WndProc `WM_USER_POST_UTF8_LOG`）抵達，即 UI 執行緒（已加註解說明）；`GetSystemStateSnapshot()`／`GetAutoActionButtonInputsForWeb()`／`GetWebSelectedAdapterUtf8()`／`MasterGet*` 皆為原子/快取讀取（repo-facts 2026-05-18/05-21 的既有 seam）。
  受影響檔案：`include/core/CoreHelpers.h`、`include/UIConstants.h`、`include/MainWindow_Internal.h`、`src/ui/MainWindow.Adapter.cpp`、`src/ui/MainWindow.Command.cpp`、`src/server/HttpServer.API.cpp`、`src/server/MainWindow.HTTP.cpp`。
  **同日後續已修（原殘留風險：跨執行緒選擇字串競爭）**：新增 `include/GuardedString.h` —— 值語意的字串包裝，**每次存取都上鎖**（`operator=`,`Copy()`,`operator std::string()`,`empty()`,`clear()`,`size()`），並刻意**不提供 `c_str()`/`data()`**（鎖內取得的指標可能超出鎖的生存期），需要指標時先 `Copy()`；另附非樣板 `==`/`!=`/`operator<<` 多載（`std::basic_string` 的對應多載是樣板，無法從 `GuardedString` 推導參數，若不加會編譯失敗）。`MainWindow_Internal.h` 的 `currentIfName`／`webSelectedIfName` 型別改為 `GuardedString`（`MainWindow.h` 於 `MainWindow_Internal.h` 之前 include 新標頭）。既有約 50 處存取點（UI thread、connect worker、watchdog、link monitor、HTTP API、SSE）**不需改寫即自動加鎖**，只有 3 處需要 `.c_str()` 的站點改為先取快照（`MainWindow.Watchdog.cpp` 與 `MainWindow.Timer.cpp:CheckAndHandleSustainedLinkLoss`、`MainWindow.Command.cpp:WM_CLOSE`），另有 3 處因多載推導／串接改為 `.Copy()`（`MainWindow.Connect.cpp` 的 OnConnect 診斷 log、`MainWindow.Timer.cpp` 的 link-down log、`MainWindow.Adapter.cpp:PopulateAdapters` 的 preferred 選擇三元式）。
  以下為修復前的風險紀錄（已解決）：
  Validation（GuardedString 化）: Build: Incremental Crash 成功（0 errors）；smoke 26/27（唯一失敗仍是既有 flakiness `test_simulation_filter_velocity_stability`）。第一次建置會出現 `error C2679/C2784`（`oss << currentIfName`、`std::string + currentIfName`、`webSelectedIfName != canonicalIfname` 等），原因是 `std::basic_string` 的對應運算子是樣板、無法從 `GuardedString` 推導 —— 已在 `GuardedString.h` 補非樣板 `==`/`!=`/`operator<<`，並把 3 處串接/三元式站點改為 `.Copy()`。另做安全版端對端驗證（`AutoTrigger=0` → web `POST /set_adapter=__SIM_ECAT6__` → `/ui_state` 安全閘確認 `selected_adapter=__SIM_ECAT6__` 後才 `/connect`）：模擬連線成功（`[Simulation] skipping NIC optimization and adapter isolation`、`All 6 slaves configured successfully`、`Simulation cyclic operation started`、`MMF1_IN started after simulation connect`），連線 worker 讀到 `currentIfName=__SIM_ECAT6__`（跨執行緒讀取正確）、`/disconnect` 正常、無 minidump；全程未觸及實體硬體，驗證後已把選取切回實體 I210 並還原 `AutoTrigger=1`。
  **原風險（已解決）**：`currentIfName`／`webSelectedIfName`（`MainWindow_Internal.h`）是 `std::string`，會被 HTTP 執行緒（`SetSelectedAdapter`）、連線 worker、watchdog/UI timer 等多執行緒讀寫（`GetWebSelectedAdapterUtf8()` 由 HTTP/SSE 執行緒呼叫），屬既有的跨執行緒資料競爭（潛在 heap 損毀）。正解是抽成單一擁有者的選擇快取（mutex 保護的 setter/getter）並改用該 API，因涉及 ~50 處呼叫點與連線流程，需獨立規劃與驗證。
  Validation: Build: Incremental Crash 成功（0 errors，僅既有 warning）；smoke 26/27（唯一失敗 `test_simulation_filter_velocity_stability` 為既有平行負載 flakiness，單獨執行 exit 0）。實機 HTTP 壓測（執行檔旁 `BigCat.ini` 暫設 `AutoTrigger=0`，避免連實體硬體）：啟動後立刻連打 `POST /login`＋`GET /ui_state`＋`GET /api/mmf/status`＋`GET /pdo_data` 共 40 輪（每輪間隔 ~200ms，含 HTTP server 尚未起來的第 1 輪）→ 除首輪 login 因伺服器未就緒回 000 外全部 200，無任何阻塞；status.log 越過 `[OK] 已完成初始化` 並印出 `[Startup] 已最小化到系統匣`。另以 `POST /set_adapter`（帶 `x-api-key`、text/plain body）驗證 post 路徑：請求即刻回 200，約 5 秒後 status.log 出現第二次 `[System IRQ Affinity] === Summary`（= `ApplySystemWideIrqAffinityToCpu0` 在 UI 執行緒被 executed），證明 `WM_USER_APPLY_SELECTED_ADAPTER_UI` 已由 UI 執行緒處理。驗證後已還原 `AutoTrigger=1`、刪除兩個可丟棄探測 .cmd。
  附註：VS Code 整合終端在此環境會間歇性失去 PowerShell cmdlet/cmd.exe 解析（`$env:Path`/PSModulePath 損壞徵兆），此時改用絕對路徑 `C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe /d /s /c "..."`（不要用前置 `&`），或直接用 VS Code task（如 `Smoke Test`）執行 repo 腳本。

- 2026-10-03 **fixed (Win11 啟動後卡在系統匣、主視窗不出現且無法操作 — 啟動期 ABBA 死鎖)**: 實機 Win11 build 26200 / Ryzen 7 5800X3D，執行檔旁 `BigCat.ini` 為 `EnableLocalHttpServer=1`、`ShowMainWindow=0`、`AutoTrigger=1`；症狀為右下只有系統匣圖示、主視窗永不出現、點圖示無反應，status.log 最後一行停在 `[OK] 已完成初始化`（= Create() 結尾）。
  以 `tools/cdb/cdb.exe -p <pid>` 附加到「仍在卡住」的行程（尚未連線、無 motion）取得堆疊：主執行緒卡在 `MSVCP140!_Mtx_lock`（同一個全域 `std::mutex`，SRWLOCK 值顯示有 waiter list，T0/T6 兩執行緒等同一把）；一個 HTTP 工作執行緒卡在 `win32u!NtUserMessageCall`，rcx=HWND、rdx=0x147（**CB_GETCURSEL**）；SSE 廣播執行緒亦在等同一把鎖。
  根因：`MainWindow::Create()` 在 HTTP 啟用時會 `StartLocalHttpServer()` + `OpenHttpOperationInterface()`（開 Chromium app 視窗）→ 其最後呼叫 `MinimizeToTray()`（**系統匣圖示因此已存在**），但 `MainWindow::MessageLoop()` 尚未開始。瀏覽器第一個輪詢（`/ui_state`）進來時，HTTP 執行緒在 `GetUiStateJson()` **持有 `g_uiStateMutex`** 期間呼叫 `GetSelectedAdapterUiState()` → `MainWindow::GetSelectedAdapterUtf8()` → **無時間上限的跨執行緒 `SendMessageW(hComboAdapter, CB_GETCURSEL)`**（`currentIfName` 為空時才走此路，啟動時正是如此）；同時 UI 執行緒走到 `Create()` 最後一行 `SetUiDisabled("adapter_select", false)` 要同一把 `g_uiStateMutex` → 互等死鎖，訊息迴圈永不啟動。Win10 機器只是 INI/時序不同（例如 HTTP 未開或請求晚到），此為啟動期 race，非 OS 特性差異。
  修復：(1) `HttpServer.API.cpp` `GetUiStateJson()` 把 `GetSelectedAdapterUiState()` 移到取得 `g_uiStateMutex` **之前**（與既有 `autoButtonState` 相同做法）— 禁止在持有全域狀態鎖時呼叫會碰 UI 的函式；(2) `MainWindow.Adapter.cpp` `GetSelectedAdapterUtf8()`（`CB_GETCURSEL`、`WM_GETTEXT`）與 `TryGetAdapterPcapNameFromComboSelection()`（`CB_GETITEMDATA`）改用 `SendMessageTimeoutW(..., SMTO_ABORTIFHUNG|SMTO_BLOCK, 100ms)`，逾時回空字串讓呼叫端退回快取；移除 `GetWindowTextW`（內部同為阻斷式 SendMessage）。
  受影響檔案：`src/server/HttpServer.API.cpp`、`src/ui/MainWindow.Adapter.cpp`。
  Validation: Build: Incremental Crash 成功（0 errors）；smoke 26/27，唯一失敗 `test_simulation_filter_velocity_stability`（訊息 `should collect enough telemetry samples`）屬既有平行負載 flakiness，單獨連跑 3 次皆 exit 0。實機啟動驗證：暫時把執行檔旁 `BigCat.ini` 設為 `AutoTrigger=0`（避免未經確認就連上實體 EtherCAT／觸發自動程序）後啟動修正版，status.log 已能越過 `[OK] 已完成初始化`，出現 `[Startup] 程式啟動流程開始` … `[Startup] 已最小化到系統匣` 及後續 IRQ affinity 訊息（修正前永久卡在 `[OK] 已完成初始化` 之後）；驗證後已還原 `AutoTrigger=1` 並結束行程。
  附註：`cdb -c "<命令>"` 由 PowerShell 傳入含反引號的 64-bit 位址時易被誤譯（會把後續字串餵進 cdb 提示字元 `0:00N>`，需手動 `qd` 才能脫離），建議先寫命令檔再用 `-cf <file>`；cdb log 屬可丟棄檔案，用完刪除。

- 2026-09-20 **fixed (RT 示波器波形水平抖動／相位雙影)**: `resources/web/RT_scope.html` 自動 X 視窗舊式為 `clamp(MAX_POINTS × 觀測樣本間隔 EMA, 1, totalRange)`，在「已累積點數 < 顯示點數」期間會退化成 `span = totalRange`，每來一筆新資料就把整個波形重新縮放一次（模擬量測：n=20 時 5.5%/frame ≈ 66px、n=100 時 0.9% ≈ 11px/frame，特徵位移恆為「一個樣本寬」）；點數累積到顯示點數後 span 被夾成固定值，故不抖 — 與現場觀察「顯示超過點數範圍才會抖」一致。
  **修復**：`getAutoViewSpanMs(totalRange, sampleCount)` 改為 `平均樣本間隔 × (MAX_POINTS - 1)`（固定窗寬），`resolveViewRange(totalRange, sampleCount)` 自動模式改為 `xMin = totalRange - span`（允許負值：右緣固定貼齊最新資料、左側留空代表該段時間尚無資料），render/wheel/pointerdown 三處呼叫端傳入樣本數。此式在滿窗（n = MAX_POINTS）時等價於 `totalRange`，與舊（已穩定）行為完全相同。
  **效果**：未滿窗期間每帧尺度變化由 5.5%/66px 降至 ≤0.27%/3.2px（n=20），n≥200 後 <0.4px/frame；滿窗 0.21px/frame 不變。此條取代 2026-05-10「default auto-X view … sized from the configured point count at the nominal 500Hz MMF input interval」的視窗寬度基準（不再使用名目/EMA 間隔，改用實際資料的平均樣本間隔）。
  同一頁另移除兩張 canvas 的 `desynchronized: true` 與 `#realtimeChart` 的 `translateZ(0)/backface-visibility`（低延遲呈現會繞過 VSync/合成器 → 捲動波形撕裂殘影；WebGL 波形與 2D 格線兩層必須同一 rAF 原子呈現），並新增 `ResizeObserver` 在容器尺寸變更時主動補重繪（drawing buffer 不落在下一筆資料才更新）。
  受影響檔案：`resources/web/RT_scope.html`。
  Validation: HTML/JS 診斷 0 error；PowerShell 模擬樣本串（~10.5ms 抖動）比對新舊公式的視窗寬度、探針像素位置與每帧尺度變化。尚未經瀏覽器實機視覺確認（示波器頁面需登入且後端有連線資料）；靜態檔直讀 `resources/web/`，但回應帶 `Cache-Control: max-age=300`，需 Ctrl+F5 才會取得新版。

- 2026-09-19 **fixed (EtherCAT 斷線後 UI 凍結 / 斷開按鈕無回應；兩處長鎖)**: 斷線 log 顯示兩段 ~24–26s 阻塞，期間 UI 執行緒無法跑 OnTimer（斷開按鈕無反應）。
  **根因 1（~24s，UI 卡死主因）**：`EC_NOFRAME`（SOEM WKC<0，NIC 完全收不到 frame）時，watchdog 仍進 `ForceSlaveOperational`；該函式**整個期間持有全域 `cs`**，對死鏈做大量注定 timeout 的 SDO（每個 `EC_TIMEOUTRXM=700ms`）＋ `ecx_statecheck(EC_TIMEOUTSTATE=2s)`。UI 執行緒任何取 `cs` 的呼叫（`GetSlaveIOBaseBytes`、`GetSlaveCount`…）全部卡住 → 斷開按鈕按了沒反應。
  **修復 1**：`CoreHelpers::CommunicationFailureSnapshot` 新增 `bool no_frame`；`EvaluateWatchdogRecoveryDecision` 在 `no_frame` 時直接回 `DisconnectImmediately`（跳過整個 recovery）。`MainWindow.Watchdog.cpp` 的 `StartWatchdogRecovery()` 傳入 `master->GetWorkingCounterRaw() < 0`，並新增對應 log 分支。no_frame = NIC 完全收不到 → SDO 復原不可能成功，直接斷開才正確。
  **根因 2（~26s，stop worker 卡住）**：`CyclicTask` 把 `EnterCriticalSection(&pdoDataCS)` **包住 `ecx_send_processdata` + `ecx_receive_processdata`**；死鏈時 `pcap_sendpacket` 在 NDIS 內可阻塞數秒 → `pdoDataCS` 長時間被 RT 執行緒持有 → 緊急停止 worker 的 `StagePDOByIndex`(→`StageOutputBytes`)/`SendProcessDataOnce` 全部卡在鎖上。
  **修復 2（拆鎖）**：`pdoDataCS` 原本**一鎖兩用**（(a) 保護 IOmap/stagedOutputs；(b) **序列化 SOEM port 交換**，見 `Init.cpp`「Hold pdoDataCS so the CyclicTask cannot send/receive … prevents SOEM port race corruption that causes WKC=0 / EC_NOFRAME」）。只把 RT 的交換移出 `pdoDataCS` 會讓連線期的 `ecx_writestate`/`ecx_readstate`（連線時 CyclicTask 已在 SAFE_OP pump）與 CyclicTask 的 send/recv 重疊 → SOEM idxstack/tx/rx 損毀。故新增獨立 `pdoExchangeCS`（`CRITICAL_SECTION`，與 `pdoDataCS` **同級、嚴禁同時持有**）：CyclicTask 先 `pdoDataCS`（只包 `ApplyStagedOutputsToIOMap`）→ 放掉 → 再 `pdoExchangeCS`（跨越 send/recv）；所有外部交換改用 `pdoExchangeCS`（`Init.cpp` OP 請求/OP-wait/retry 共 4 處 `ecx_writestate`/`ecx_readstate`、`SDO.cpp` `ForceSlaveOperational` 的 group OP send/recv/writestate）。效果：worker 只碰 `pdoDataCS`（RT 僅短暫持有）不再卡 26s；SOEM 交換互斥恢復。`pdoExchangeCS` 正常運作時無其他競爭者，RT 週期不受影響。
  **死碼查核**：`PerSlaveCyclicTask` / `StartSlaveThread`（`Cyclic.cpp:2410`/`2455`）**無任何呼叫者**（`HasActiveSlaveThreads()` 只回 `isRunning`，不看 `slaveThreads`）→ 非第三條交換路徑，不改。
  **未改（既有且安全）**：`ForceSlaveOperational` Step-5 重試交換（`SDO.cpp:791`）、`ConfigureSlaves`/`PumpProcessDataUntilStable`（`Init.cpp:44/70/770`）本來就未受 `pdoDataCS` 保護（既有現況），且僅在 CyclicTask 停止或尚未啟動時執行。
  受影響檔案：`include/core/CoreHelpers.h`、`include/EtherCATMaster.h`、`src/ethercat/EtherCATMaster.cpp`、`src/ui/MainWindow.Watchdog.cpp`、`src/ethercat/EtherCATMaster.Cyclic.cpp`、`src/ethercat/EtherCATMaster.Init.cpp`、`src/ethercat/EtherCATMaster.SDO.cpp`。

- 2026-06-27 **fixed (Win11 RT core pin regression)**: `PinCurrentThreadToRtCores` 的 destructive round-trip 驗證在 Win11 上導致 cyclic thread 跑到錯誤的 CPU。根因：驗證先 `SetThreadAffinityMask(hThread, sysMask)` 暫時放寬到所有核心，再 `SetThreadAffinityMask(hThread, rtThreadMask_)` 縮回 RT 核心。Win11 排程器在放寬瞬間將 thread 遷移到非 RT 核心，而縮回操作只設定允許遮罩不強制即時遷移 — TIME_CRITICAL thread 可能停留在錯誤核心直到下次 quantum。
  **修復**:
  1. `ApplyRealtimeThreadBoost`（MMCSS Pro Audio 註冊）移至 `SetThreadAffinityMask` 之前，確保 MMCSS 軟提示不覆蓋硬親和性。
  2. Round-trip 驗證替換為 non-destructive re-assertion：第二次 `SetThreadAffinityMask(hThread, rtThreadMask_)`（相同遮罩），檢查回傳值是否等於 `rtThreadMask_`。若被 silent clamp，回傳值會不同。
  3. 添加 `SwitchToThread()` 強制 context switch，確保排程器在進入 PDO 迴圈前遷移 thread。
  4. `CyclicTask` 的 runtime verification 亦改為 non-destructive re-assertion（移除 widen→narrow 模式）。
  5. `DiagnoseRtCoreState` 中的診斷用 round-trip 保留（非 RT thread、非效能關鍵路徑）。
  受影響檔案：`src/core/CpuIsolation.cpp`、`src/ethercat/EtherCATMaster.Cyclic.cpp`。

- 2026-06-26 **fixed (affinity verification)**: PinCurrentThreadToRtCores 驗證邏輯缺陷修復。
  1. 原有驗證僅在 `prev != rtThreadMask_` 時執行；當 INIT 已 preset affinity 使 `prev == rtThreadMask_` 時全程跳過。
     修復：一律執行 round-trip (sysMask → rtThreadMask_) 驗證，並檢查 SetThreadAffinityMask 回傳值確認成功。
  2. CyclicTask 驗證碼 `DWORD_PTR sysAffinity = 0` 未經 `GetProcessAffinityMask` 初始化，
     `SetThreadAffinityMask(hCur, 0)` 永遠失敗 → 驗證靜默跳過。修復：正確調用 `GetProcessAffinityMask`。
  3. Legacy fallback 使用 `(DWORD_PTR)1 << rtPhysicalCore_`（實體核心索引當邏輯 CPU 位元），SMT 系統上綁錯核心；
     `rtPhysicalCore_ == -1` 時為 UB。修復：改用 `CpuTopology::GetPrimaryLpMask(物理核心→邏輯CPU)`,
     並加入 `rtPhysicalCore_ >= 0` 防護。覆蓋 CyclicTask / Init.cpp / MonitorThreadLoop / RepelOnce。
  4. Init.cpp 中 `GetLastError()` 無 `::` 前綴 → 呼叫 `EtherCATMaster::GetLastError()` 回傳 `std::string`，
     導致 `static_cast<unsigned long>` 編譯失敗。修復：`::GetLastError()`。
  Validation: Build: Incremental Crash + Smoke Test (26/26 passed)。

- 2026-06-26 refactored: CPU topology now centralized through `CpuTopology` as single source of truth. All `GetLogicalProcessorInformationEx` calls outside `CpuTopology.cpp` replaced with `CpuTopology` API. Key changes:
  - `CpuIsolation::DetectCpuTopology` delegates to `CpuTopology::Cores()` instead of raw API calls.
  - `PhysicalCoreToKaAffinityMask` / `LogicalCpuToPhysicalCoreIndex` in `CoreHelpers.cpp` replaced with `CpuTopology::GetPrimaryLpMask` / `CpuTopology::FindCoreByLp`.
  - `ApplySystemWideIrqAffinityToCpu0` uses `CpuTopology::GetPrimaryLpMask` for mask building (topology-aware, no hardcoded CPU numbers).
  - `RedirectUsbIrqAffinityFromRtCore` / `RedirectNicIrqFromRtCore` now use proper RT core mask (`GetRtCoreMask()`) instead of `1 << physicalCoreIndex`.
  - `SetDeviceIrqAffinityToCpu` now accepts logical CPU (Task Manager numbering) directly, not physical core index.
  - `GetAdapterEffectiveIrqCpu` / `GetDeviceInstanceEffectiveIrqCpu` return logical CPU (Task Manager numbering) instead of converting to physical core index.
  - `EtherCATMaster::BuildCoreCandidates` uses `CpuTopology::Cores()` instead of `GetLogicalProcessorInformation`.
  - `main.cpp` candidate list building uses `CpuTopology::PhysicalCoreCount()` / `LogicalProcessorCount()`.
  - `CpuTopology` added helpers: `GetPrimaryLpMask`, `GetCoreMask`, `BuildMultiCoreMask`.
  - All UI CPU displays now use Task Manager numbering (logical CPU index). Display labels changed from "P%d" to "CPU%d".
  - RT core display on main window (`hStaticRtCore`) now shows logical CPU (Task Manager) + physical core + SMT sibling info.
  - Startup/connect-time status messages now report RT CPU as "CPU N (實體核心 #M)".
  Validation: Build: Incremental Crash + Smoke Test (26/26 passed)。

- 2026-06-19 fixed: DVS/X1S 驅動器預設 0x607F (Max Profile Velocity) = 0，導致 CSV 模式所有速度命令被歸零。在 SAFE_OP SDO 階段（Init.cpp 步驟 8.6）寫入 0x607F=1000000000、0x6083/0x6084=10000000，解除驅動器內部箝位。同時修正 X1S (vid=0x766) PDO 映射與 SDO 寫入使用正確的轉矩限制索引：X1S 使用 0x2019/0x201A，DVS 使用 0x60E0/0x60E1（PDO byte layout 相同）。新增 `EtherCATMaster::IsX1sDrive/GetTorqueLimitPosIdx/GetTorqueLimitNegIdx` 輔助方法。驗證：Build: Incremental Crash + Smoke Test (26/26 passed)。

- 2026-06-21 fixed: 自動畫面「到下原點」按鈕閃退（Access Violation in memmove）。根因：SOEM `ecx_mbxreceive()` 在 mailbox pool 耗盡時 `ecx_getmbx()` 回傳 NULL 未檢查，以及 internal do-while 迴圈中收到 mailbox error/emergency 後 `mbxin` 被設為 NULL 但迴圈繼續執行 → 下一輪 `ecx_FPRD(mbxin=NULL)` → `memcpy(NULL, ...)` 崩潰。修復：`lib/SOEM/src/ec_main.c` 中 (1) `ecx_getmbx()` 後新增 NULL 檢查；(2) do-while 迴圈頂部新增 NULL guard；(3) "read mailbox lost" 分支新增 NULL guard 避免無 buffer 重試。驗證：Build: Incremental Crash + Smoke Test (26/26 passed)。
  1. ramp-lag 閾值從 0.12 提升至 0.25 度：因輸入 MA 平滑已停用（避免與上游 MMF pre-filter 雙重濾波），改用 raw iSetValue，理論穩態延遲 ~0.257 度。
  2. global-limiting + local-violation 場景：當全域限制中的軸出現自身速度違規時，PDOFilter 必須恢復設定加速/減速（提供完整制動能力）。新增 `ioGlobalLimitingForced_` 分支於速度/加速違規處理路徑。
  3. 測試中 `iAllowInputPrediction=true` 導致預測覆蓋量測速度（-200 deg/s），違規偵測失敗 → 改為 `false`。
  驗證：Build: Incremental Crash + Smoke Test (26/26 passed)。

Repository text encoding default: UTF-8 without BOM.
Files containing Chinese must be saved as UTF-8 without BOM. Do not convert project text files to ANSI, Big5, UTF-8 BOM, or other locale-dependent encodings.
MSVC source compilation in this repo is configured for UTF-8 via `/utf-8` in `CMakeLists.txt`, and edited repository text files should stay UTF-8 without BOM.
Win32 UI boundaries may still require wide strings / UTF-16 helpers, but repository text files and exchanged text payloads should stay UTF-8 without BOM.

- 2026-06-15 verified: PDO mapping expanded from 4+4 to 7+7 entries (matching Startup.csv). 0x60FD, 0x603F, 0x6061 are now read from TxPDO every cycle; 0x6060 is written via RxPDO staging. The old SDO reader thread (SdoReaderTick) is now a no-op — 0x60FD is cached atomically in pdo60FDCache_ from the cyclic thread. GetLastSdo60FD/GetLastSdo60FDLowByte APIs remain for backward compatibility but read from the PDO atomic cache. PDO byte layout: RxPDO[0-11] unchanged offsets, [12]=0x6060(1B), [13]=0x60E0(2B), [15]=0x60E1(2B); TxPDO[0-11] unchanged, [12]=0x6061(1B), [13]=0x603F(2B), [15]=0x60FD(4B). PowerOn, PowerOnAll, FaultReset, HomeAsync SDO paths all migrated to PDO. Validated with Build: Incremental Crash (142/142 passed).
- 2026-06-06 verified: added real-time Windows power policy optimization (`CoreHelpers::ApplyRealtimePowerPolicy`) called at startup in `main.cpp` before license check. Uses `powrprof.h` Power* C++ APIs (no PowerShell): activates Ultimate Performance power scheme (GUID `{e9a42b02...}`) with High Performance fallback (`{8c5e7fda...}`), disables core parking (min cores=0), disables USB selective suspend, and disables disk timeout (never turn off). Non-fatal when Admin is unavailable. `bigcat_core` now links `powrprof.lib`. Validated with `Build: Incremental Crash`.
- 2026-06-06 verified: added OS-level hard CPU core isolation (`CpuIsolation::InitializeHardIsolation` + `PinCurrentThreadToRtCores`). Uses `GetLogicalProcessorInformationEx` (RelationProcessorCore) to detect the physical→logical core mapping and isolate ALL logical cores belonging to the target physical core (default Core 4). `ApplyProcessLevelIsolation()` sets the process affinity to exclude the RT core set — only the cyclic thread may run there via `PinCurrentThreadToRtCores()`. The existing software monitor continues to repel DCS/SteamVR from RT cores. Cyclic thread entry in `EtherCATMaster.Cyclic.cpp` now prefers `PinCurrentThreadToRtCores()` over the legacy single-bit Core 4 affinity, with automatic fallback. Validated with `Build: Incremental Crash`.
- 2026-06-25 **fixed (critical)**: `ApplyProcessLevelIsolation` was calling `SetProcessAffinityMask` to exclude RT cores from the process mask, which silently broke `SetThreadAffinityMask` for the cyclic thread — Windows requires thread masks to be a subset of the process mask. The cyclic thread's `PinCurrentThreadToRtCores` call always failed, dropping it onto a shared core via round-robin fallback → SOEM disconnects. **Fix**: removed `SetProcessAffinityMask` exclusion; process mask now stays at full system mask. Main/UI thread is pinned to non-RT cores via per-thread `SetThreadAffinityMask`. Cyclic thread successfully pins to RT core (subset of process mask ✓). Monitor continues to repel foreign processes. Validated: `Build: Incremental Crash` + smoke (26/26).

- 2026-06-12 verified: cdb.exe (Windows Debugger v10.0.29547.1002) bundled at `tools/cdb/` with supporting DLLs (dbgeng.dll, dbghelp.dll, srcsrv.dll, symsrv.dll). `scripts/analyze_dump_and_prepare_ai_prompt.ps1` (`Find-Cdb`) checks this project-bundled copy first, then PATH, then Windows Kits. Validated with crash dump analysis on `BigCat_crash_20260612_225306.dmp`.
- 2026-06-12 fixed: `stagedOutputs` data race in `EtherCATMaster.Cyclic.cpp`. `PDOProcessingTask` wrote to `stagedOutputs` under `pdoFilterCS_` while `CyclicTask` read it under `pdoDataCS` — different critical sections, no mutual exclusion. This corrupted the `std::map` allocator, causing a NULL-pointer `memmove` crash during soft-start→MMF transition. Fix: deferred all `stagedOutputs` writes to after `LeaveCriticalSection(&pdoFilterCS_)`, applied under `EnterCriticalSection(&pdoDataCS)` to match CyclicTask's lock. Validated: `Build: Incremental Crash` + smoke tests (25/26 passed; `test_simulation_filter_velocity_stability` borderline: 8.05 vs 8.0 threshold, pre-existing).

- 2026-06-13 fixed: `lastError` (`std::string`) data race in `EtherCATMaster`. `SetError` was called from CyclicTask, PDOProcessingTask, SDO, simulation, and UI/HTTP threads without synchronization — concurrent writes to `std::string` cause heap allocator corruption (same class as the `stagedOutputs` race above). Fix: added `CRITICAL_SECTION errorCS_` protecting all reads/writes to `lastError`; `GetLastError()` now returns a copy under lock. Also eliminated `std::stringstream` heap allocations from CyclicTask hot paths (stagedOutputs error reporting, lock-hold warning, verboseCyclicLog save/restore) by replacing them with stack-allocated `char` buffers + `snprintf`. The verboseCyclicLog save/restore pattern (`std::string tempError = lastError` + restore) was removed; verbose diagnostics now simply call `SetError` directly. Validated: `Build: Incremental Crash` + smoke tests (26/26 passed).

- 2026-06-13 fixed: nested-lock risk (`pdoFilterCS_` → `pdoDataCS`) in `EtherCATMaster.Cyclic.cpp` `clearHardOutwardCsvNow` path. Removed the direct IOmap write under nested locks; the same zero-velocity command is already staged via `deferredStagedWrites` and applied under correct lock ordering on the next PDO cycle. Added explicit lock-ordering hierarchy comment in `include/EtherCATMaster.h` documenting the required acquisition order for all 7 CRITICAL_SECTIONs. Also moved `MMF1Reader.PollOnce()` from CyclicTask to PDOProcessingTask (the sole consumer of MMF data), eliminating non-deterministic memory-mapped-file I/O latency from the PDO cycle path. Additionally eliminated remaining `std::stringstream` heap allocations in `SendProcessDataOnce`, `WriteOutputBytes`, `StageOutputBytes`, and `StageOutputIfNotExists` error paths (all operate under `pdoDataCS` or `cs`). Hardened `FilterWithInputState` exception handler in PDOProcessingTask: on filter exception, now resets CSV velocity command state and clears filter error flags to prevent propagating inconsistent state from a partially-modified filter. Validated: `Build: Incremental Crash` + smoke tests (26/26 passed) × 3 rounds.

  **階段一**（低速穩態震動）：(1) 軟啟動後當 feedforward 非零時速度阻尼完全關閉，低速前饋時修正迴路（tau=120ms, accel=0.08）缺乏阻尼導致振盪 → 加入 `kCsvLowSpeedDampingThresholdRatio=0.15`，前饋低於 15% 最大速度時啟用阻尼（limit=0.50 vs 正常 0.25）。(2) `feedbackLeadLowSpeedInhibit` 零化 `desiredCommandVelocity` 後 acceleration-limited step 已衰減一次，又做顯式 bleed → command velocity 每週期衰減兩倍 → 軟啟動後移除重複的顯式 bleed，保留軟啟動期間的顯式 bleed（因其 decel 已偏低）。

  **階段二**（外力推壓觸發震動）：追蹤箝位 (tracking clamp) 與慢速修正濾波器互動導致振盪。外力推壓超過追蹤誤差窗 (>5°) → PDOFilter 箝位觸發，`GetInternalVelocity()` 被抑制為 0 → 外力釋放後箝位解除，feeddforward 從 0 跳躍 → 120ms tau 修正濾波器相位延遲過大 → 修正/前饋錯位產生振盪。修復：(1) 追蹤箝位活躍時使用自適應快速修正濾波器：`kCsvTrackingClampCorrectionFilterTauSec=0.050`（vs 正常 0.120）和 `kCsvTrackingClampCorrectionAccelRatio=0.20`（vs 正常 0.08）。(2) 追蹤箝位解除時（`prevClampDir != 0 → clampDir == 0`）重置 CSV 修正狀態（correctionVelocity / smoothedError / integralError）以防止累積誤差放大 `GetInternalVelocity()` 的跳躍瞬變。驗證：`Build: Incremental Crash` 和 `Smoke Test`（26/26 passed）。

- 2026-05-28 fixed: Stewart IK 動態 Z 觸發行程縮放（`ValidatePose6D`）。硬限制超出時 freeze，動態縮放啟用時改以 `clampedPose` 過飽和值檢查。Z 軸不縮放。縮放曲線原為 cosine easing（`smoothT = (1−cos(π·t))/2`），2026-07-14 先改為 quintic S-curve（`smoothT = 10t³−15t⁴+6t⁵`），同日再升級為 septic S-curve（`smoothT = −20t⁷+70t⁶−84t⁵+35t⁴`）以消除 jerk 跳變（septic 一階/二階/三階導數在 t=0,1 皆為零，S 曲線特性加倍）。參數集中定義於 `include/StewartIK.h: Pose6DDynamicDefaults`（kStartRatio=0.50=50%, kMinScale=0.50=50%），runtime 可由 `Par/machine.xml` 覆寫。縮放啟用/關閉時 trigger 單次 UI 警報與 log（`IsPose6DDynamicScalingActive` / `ConsumePose6DDynamicScalingMessage`）。2026-07-14 新增：動態縮放啟用時透過 `PDOFilter::ApplyDynamicScalingAccelLimits(true)` 將 6 軸 PDO filter 加減速限制降為設定值 0.5x（使用 `std::min` 確保不覆蓋 soft-start 更嚴格的限制），關閉時恢復。
- 2026-05-28 verified: PDO filter `inhibitCorrection` 在追蹤誤差 latch 後需加入 `!feedforwardAwayFromClamp` 條件，否則命令反轉往追蹤誤差變小方向時仍抑制 position error 修正導致雙向卡住。修復在 `EtherCATMaster.Cyclic.cpp` L375-380。
- 2026-05-28 fixed: PDO filter 追蹤誤差致命 latch (`ioTrackingErrorFatalActive_`) 觸發後即使誤差回到容許窗內也無法自動解除，因為 `ioErrorFlag_` 會 clamp `iSetValue` 到 `iActValue` 使軸凍結，且 latch 永不被清除。修復在 `PDOFilter.cpp` 加入恢復路徑：當致命 latch 啟用中但誤差已回到窗內且縮至參考值一半以下時，清除 latch 與 error flag 讓軸恢復追蹤。

- 2026-05-02 verified: `resources/web/viewer_6dof.html` now supports switching between local UI sliders and external MMF 6DOF input. External mode must reuse `/pdo_sse` `slaves[*].mmfIn` with a `/pdo_data` snapshot warm-up instead of adding a new backend path, must keep the MMF SSE subscription alive across source-checkbox toggles so external input does not appear to lose signal when switching back, and must distinguish DOM `input` events from explicit transform-value objects so manual sliders keep working. The viewer labels map MMF order `Sway, Surge, Heave, Pitch, Roll, FYaw` to `X, Y, Z, Pitch, Yaw, Roll` as `posX=0`, `posY=1`, `posZ=2`, `rotX=3`, `rotY=5`, `rotZ=4`. - 2026-08-01 fixed: `resources/web/viewer_6dof.html` external MMF mode rendered Yaw/Pitch/Roll differently from the manual slider path. Root fix and simplification: remove the separate absolute-pose renderer `applyAbsoluteMmfPose()` entirely and have `applyLatestMmfPose()` just write the MMF values into the corresponding sliders via `syncTransformInputs()` and then call the shared `updateTransform()` — the same incremental path manual mode uses (already verified correct), so MMF rendering is guaranteed identical to manual for the same values instead of maintaining a divergent absolute-pose implementation. Also fixed the rotation center: the model must rotate about its own geometric center, so translation now goes to `offsetGroup.position` and rotation to `rotGroup.quaternion` (rotGroup origin = model center) while `pivot.position` stays at `pivotBase`; the per-model `forwardZ` cosmetic offset moved from `model.position` to `rotGroup.position` so the model body stays centered on the rotation point. Verified with browser probes: MMF and manual produce identical `rotGroup` quaternions for identical inputs, model geometric center stays constant under rotation, and manual/MMF toggle + reset flows still work.
- 2026-05-03 verified: `SetBusyFlagAndNotify()` and `RequestMotionUiRefresh()` must not refresh the main-window motion area by posting a synthetic slave-combobox `CBN_SELCHANGE`. Auto start toggles several busy flags in sequence, and reusing the real slave-selection handler rebuilds PDO controls and selected-slave status unnecessarily, causing visible button/input flicker. Keep busy-state refresh on `WM_USER_AUTO_REPORT_UI_STATE` with a lightweight confirmed-slave control-state path, and reserve full PDO/status rebuilds for real slave selection changes. Validated with `Build: Incremental Crash` and `Smoke Test` (9/9 passed).
- 2026-05-03 verified: the auto-start bootstrap path must batch main-window motion refreshes so the main window updates once when `StartAutoProcedure()` locks the UI and once when the bootstrap thread finishes or fails. During that batch, `RequestMotionUiRefresh()` should only mark a pending main-window refresh; the final `WM_USER_AUTO_REPORT_UI_STATE` flush belongs at the end of the bootstrap scope rather than on each intermediate `faultResetBusy`, `powerOpBusy`, or manual-reset transition. Validated with `Build: Incremental Crash` and `Smoke Test` (9/9 passed).
- 2026-05-03 verified: reducing auto-start to two logical UI refreshes is not sufficient by itself; the visible flicker also comes from one refresh pass mutating many Win32 controls sequentially. Skip redundant `EnableWindow` calls when the requested state already matches, but do not suppress redraw by toggling `WM_SETREDRAW` plus full `RedrawWindow(...RDW_ALLCHILDREN...)` on the main window or content host: that escalates the issue into whole-window flashing that looks like controls are being recreated. Validated with `Build: Incremental Crash` and `Smoke Test` (9/9 passed).
- 2026-05-04 verified: the desktop main window must continue live UI refresh during auto execution whenever the window is visible; gating `OnTimer()` or `RequestMotionUiRefresh()` on `autoProcedureStartPending` / `autoProcedureRunning` makes the main window appear frozen during Auto. Suppress main-window repaint work only when the window is minimized to tray, minimized to taskbar, or otherwise hidden; the auto-start startup batch should still coalesce intermediate bootstrap refreshes. Validated with `Build: Incremental Crash` and `Smoke Test` (9/9 passed).
- 2026-05-03 verified: the remaining PDO input/apply flicker came from the PDO area being toggled twice per auto-start transition. `StartAutoProcedure()` / `StopAutoProcedure()` must not manually toggle PDO input/apply controls if `ApplyAutoProcedureUiLockState()` or the final `RefreshConfirmedSlaveControlState(false)` already owns that slice, and the shared `SetControlEnabled()` helper used by `PDOProxy` must skip no-op `EnableWindow` calls. Otherwise the main window can satisfy the high-level two-refresh rule while the PDO edit/apply region still visibly flashes from duplicate enable/disable passes. Validated with `Build: Incremental Crash` and `Smoke Test` (9/9 passed).
- 2026-05-04 verified: AutoWindow-driven `WM_USER_AUTO_REPORT_UI_STATE` updates should follow the same visible-window gate as `RequestMotionUiRefresh()`, not an unconditional auto-lock block. Visible auto runs need those owner refreshes to keep the main-window controls/status in sync, while minimized or hidden windows may skip the refresh pass entirely. Validated with `Build: Incremental Crash` and `Smoke Test` (9/9 passed).
- 2026-05-04 verified: HTTP `/status` uses `g_lastStatusUtf8` as a recent-status cache, not an unbounded audit log. All writes and fallback/reject/throttle appends must route through the shared status-cache helper in `src/server/HttpServer.API.Helpers.cpp` so the cache stays size-bounded while preserving the newest lines; do not append directly to `g_lastStatusUtf8`. - 2026-05-04 verified: `MainWindow::OnHome()` must latch `homingBusy` on the UI thread to block duplicate clicks, but its background busy-conflict guard must exclude that same `homingBusy` bit; otherwise the main-window Origin Set button self-rejects every request as `系統忙碌` before homing starts. - 2026-05-05 verified: important UI button flows emit many UTF-8 status and SDO batch messages through `MainWindow::PostUTF8LogToUI`, `MainWindow::PostUTF8LogToHWND`, and `MainWindow::PostSDOItemToHWND`. - 2026-05-05 verified: AutoWindow stop/policy/button-sync hot paths should read SDO `0x60FD` through the dedicated low-byte accessor (`MainWindow::TryGetLastSdo60FDLowByte` / `EtherCATMaster::GetLastSdo60FDLowByte`) instead of copying the full cached byte vector and taking `back()`. - 2026-05-05 verified: AutoWindow's 50ms refresh path should format actual-position and MMF display text into fixed stack buffers and compare cached `std::wstring` values against those buffers, rather than constructing temporary `std::wstring`/`std::wstringstream` objects on every timer tick. - 2026-05-09 verified-by-source: the default cyclic EtherCAT motion path now runs in CSV (`CoreHelpers::kDefaultCyclicOperationMode` = 9) while `src/ethercat/EtherCATMaster.Cyclic.cpp` still stages `0x607A` as a logical target/telemetry channel alongside the real `0x60FF` velocity command. Disabling PDO filtering must clear staged values for both `0x607A` and `0x60FF`, not only `0x607A`, or stale filter output can continue driving the CSV path after filtering is turned off.
- 2026-05-09 verified: disabling PDO filtering must also zero the current IOmap bytes for both the logical target channel (`0x607A`) and the active CSV command channel (`0x60FF`), not just erase their staged-output entries; otherwise the last CSV velocity command remains latched after filtering is turned off. Guarded by `tests/test_csv_disable_filter_clears_command.cpp` and validated with `build_incremental-Crash.ps1` plus `scripts/run_smoke_tests.ps1 -BuildDir .\build -Config Release`.
- 2026-05-09 verified: simulation reconnect/shutdown must clear cached `stagedOutputs` even when the PDO processing thread is already stopped; otherwise stale staged `0x607A` / `0x60FF` commands can replay into the next virtual session and create runaway-looking actual-angle logs during Auto Connect. - 2026-05-09 verified: PDOFilter soft-start fatal tracking must be based on the command actually issued by the filter versus actual feedback, not on the far upstream MMF target that soft-start is still ramping toward. - 2026-05-09 verified: simulation Auto Connect soft-start regression `tests/test_simulation_softstart_no_fatal_tracking.cpp` starts MMF1_IN, runs simulation cyclic mode, enables mode 9 plus operation enabled, triggers all PDO filters soft-start toward a 30-degree target, and asserts no fatal tracking/error within the first 0.65 seconds plus bounded actual position. - 2026-05-09 verified: `EtherCATMaster::AdvanceSimulation()` clamps only the virtual plant integration step to a small multiple of the configured cycle period so a Windows scheduling stall cannot be integrated as a huge single-cycle actual-position jump; this does not change real EtherCAT cyclic timing.
- 2026-05-09 verified: manual jog startup in `src/motion/MotionController.cpp` must use `CoreHelpers::kDefaultCyclicOperationMode` instead of forcing PV mode 3, otherwise the app keeps reintroducing a second motion-mode contract after the CSV migration. - 2026-05-09 verified: `MotionController::HomeAsync()` must restore the default cyclic mode and stage `0x60FF=0` after homing completes, because `MainWindow::OnHome()` and related callers do not issue a follow-up power-on/mode-switch step; leaving the drive in mode 6 breaks later CSV-based motion assumptions. Validated with `build_incremental-Crash.ps1` (Release) and `scripts/run_smoke_tests.ps1 -BuildDir .\build -Config Release`.
- 2026-05-09 verified: mechanical position PDOs (`0x6064` actual and `0x607A` logical target) are converted to single-turn degrees before UI metrics, MMF output, and PDOFilter tracking; velocity PDOs remain unwrapped. This prevents multi-turn encoder feedback such as `-35736°` from entering AutoWindow actual-angle display or CSV soft-start tracking. Guarded by `tests/test_simulation_multiturn_actual_position_normalized.cpp` plus the simulation soft-start smoke tests.
- 2026-05-09 verified: simulation tests should avoid redundant explicit shutdown immediately before `EtherCATMaster` destruction; the destructor already shuts down simulation mode. Extra post-test shutdown can fall through to the generic EtherCAT shutdown path after simulation state has been cleared and make CTest appear hung.
- 2026-05-09 verified: all fallback/manual PDO output writers must resolve PDO offsets by registered descriptor index first and only fall back to the standard CSV layout (`0x6040` +0, `0x607A` +2, `0x60FF` +6, `0x6071` +10). Writing every pending output at `outBase` corrupts the controlword and hides CSV velocity-command mistakes.
- 2026-05-09 verified: ForceSlaveOperational/runtime recovery PDO remapping must match the CSV layout used by Initialize/Simulation (`0x6040`, `0x607A`, `0x60FF`, `0x6071`; Tx `0x6041`, `0x6064`, `0x606C`, `0x6077`). Reintroducing legacy `0x6081` between `0x607A` and `0x60FF` shifts the CSV command offset and breaks the active 0x60FF contract.
- 2026-05-09 verified: simulation shutdown must stop the PDO processing thread before the simulation cyclic thread, because both virtual-mode loops can contend for `pdoDataCS` during teardown; stopping cyclic first can hang CTest/build-working-directory simulation tests at process exit.
- 2026-05-10 verified: simulation `AdvanceSimulation()` must mirror real EtherCAT PDO timing by updating virtual feedback from the IOmap command already sent in the prior cycle, then applying `stagedOutputs` for the next cycle. Applying staged filter outputs before virtual plant integration creates zero-cycle feedback and makes Auto Connect/PDOFilter soft-start differ from field behavior.
- 2026-05-09 verified: Auto Connect soft-start monitoring must not convert a non-fatal `TrackingError` guard into an emergency stop while `PDOFilter::IsSoftStartActive()` is true. During healthy CSV soft-start the filter may hold issued output near the tightened 5-degree tracking window while the axis catches up; abort only when the filter reports `IsError()` or `IsTrackingErrorFatal()`.
- 2026-05-09 verified: PDOFilter/UI display can normalize `0x6064`/`0x607A` positions to a single turn, but CSV control must unwrap actual position near the current filter command/reference before passing feedback into `PDOFilter::Filter()`. Otherwise crossing +/-180 degrees in simulation or field feedback looks like a 360-degree tracking jump, destabilizing `0x60FF` velocity and latching false tracking errors.
- 2026-05-10 verified: `PDOFilter::Filter()` final-output ordering must apply the `iActValue ± trackingErrorWindow` clamp first and then a hard `[iMinPDO_, iMaxPDO_]` clamp last; otherwise when `iActValue` is already past a configured PDO position limit (manual push, tightened limits mid-flight, or a fault) the tracking-error window expands the output back outside the PDO envelope and the slave is told to move further past the limit. When the hard PDO clamp engages and `oCurrentVelocity_` still points outward, bleed it toward zero using at least the configured deceleration (`max(abs(iMaxDeceleration_), abs(iConfiguredMaxDeceleration_)) * iCycleTime_`) so CSV `feedforwardVelocity = GetInternalVelocity()` does not retain a residual outward velocity that keeps `0x60FF` driving the motor at constant speed past the limit. Guarded by `tests/test_pdofilter_pdo_limit_velocity_decay.cpp` (closed-loop and stuck-actual-past-limit cases for both upper and lower PDO limits).
- 2026-05-10 verified: `PDOFilter::Filter()` `MeasurementMismatch` handling must clamp the original incoming command into `iActValue ± trackingErrorWindow`; do not replace it with the stale issued-command side (`iActValue + copysign(window, issuedCommand-actual)`) and do not source it from a prior input-anomaly prediction. Otherwise after the user/MMF input returns low, tracking-error protection can keep commanding the old outward boundary and make Filter output run away while the Filter input trace stays low. When tracking/hard-limit safety boundaries are active, braking/bleed must use configured decel even if global limiting has reduced current decel to the soft-start ratio; the field signature was `A=-120` after a 600 deg/s² config, which leaves enough stopping distance for a 70-90 deg/s residual velocity to hit the position limit. In addition, `EtherCATMaster::ComputeCsvVelocityCommand()` must inhibit CSV correction directionally with `PDOFilter::GetTrackingClampDirection()` and immediately clear same-direction outward `correctionVelocity`/`commandVelocity` components; otherwise a stale positive `0x60FF` target can continue pushing the virtual/real axis after the filter boundary engages. Guarded by the tracking guard-source, configured-decel safety-braking, tracking-window-bleed, and tracking-error-recovery blocks in `tests/test_pdofilter_velocity_continuity.cpp`; validated with focused PDOFilter CTest (4/4) and Release smoke (20/20).
- 2026-05-09 verified: CSV `0x60FF` must be a closed-loop velocity command derived from filter feedforward plus `(filtered target - actual position)` correction under the current PDOFilter velocity/deceleration limits; using only the filter output derivative can leave actual feedback stopped away from target, so Pose6D virtual Auto Connect soft-start never becomes ready. Guarded by `tests/test_simulation_pose6d_softstart_completes.cpp` plus the CSV soft-start smoke tests.
- 2026-05-09 verified: Auto Connect completion must preserve AutoWindow `oOnline` when PDO filtering remains enabled; the completion path should clear only the busy bit and derive the online bit from `EtherCATMaster::IsPDOFilteringEnabled()`. Sending owner state `0` after a successful CSV soft-start can briefly or permanently extinguish the online lamp even though cyclic filtering is active.
- 2026-05-09 verified: simulation/online Filter velocity telemetry should publish PDOFilter internal planned velocity/acceleration, because final-output delta velocity is disturbed by tracking-window clamps and appears unstable in RT scope. CSV feedforward may use that internal velocity after soft-start, but soft-start `0x60FF` must stay capped to the soft-start velocity envelope plus the bounded CSV correction margin so Pose6D soft-start still completes without exceeding the existing velocity guard. Guarded by `tests/test_simulation_filter_velocity_stability.cpp`, `tests/test_simulation_pose6d_softstart_completes.cpp`, and Smoke Test (16/16 passed).
- 2026-05-09 verified: simulation Filter-speed sawtooth was caused by PDOFilter input-anomaly replacement during sparse MMF updates. After several stale/predicted cycles, the replacement must continue from `ioPrevEffectiveSetpoint_`; anchoring back to the previous raw MMF sample creates a real backward snap in the effective target and a visible velocity kink. Continuous per-cycle jumps should still use the raw-sample anchor so tracking-mismatch protection reports `MeasurementMismatch`. Guarded by tightened `tests/test_simulation_filter_velocity_stability.cpp` (`maxVelocityJump <= 3.0`), `tests/test_pdofilter_velocity_continuity.cpp`, and Smoke Test (16/16 passed).
- 2026-05-09 verified: simulation-mode PDOFilter must use MMFReader per-axis update counters, not value equality alone, to distinguish real new MMF samples from held samples. In simulation, `FilterWithInputState(..., allowPrediction=false)` consumes the actual MMF-held value without prediction substitution; Pose6D input treats any source pose-channel update as a new sample for all six derived servo-angle setpoints. Guarded by `tests/test_pdofilter_velocity_continuity.cpp`, `tests/test_simulation_filter_velocity_stability.cpp`, and Smoke Test (16/16 passed).
- 2026-05-09 verified: PDOFilter's prediction-return bridge (`(raw + movingAverage) / 2`) must only run after the previous cycle actually used prediction. When simulation consumes real held MMF samples with prediction disabled, applying that bridge on the first new sample makes the effective setpoint jump forward then fall back to the moving average on the next held cycle, producing real Filter-output instability. Guarded by the held-MMF step regression in `tests/test_pdofilter_velocity_continuity.cpp` and the 1ms-sampled `tests/test_simulation_filter_velocity_stability.cpp`; Smoke Test passed 16/16.
- 2026-05-09 verified: RT scope/MMF fields `tPos`, `tVel`, `aPos`, and `aVel` must stay sourced from the PDO snapshot reads for `0x607A`, `0x60FF`, `0x6064`, and `0x606C` respectively. Do not overwrite those fields with predicted MMF/filter-internal values; `filter`, `filterVel`, and `filterAcc` are the dedicated PDOFilter telemetry channels. Validated with `build_incremental-Crash.ps1 -NonInteractive`, focused CSV/filter CTest, and Smoke Test (16/16 passed).
- 2026-05-09 verified: a held/constant MMF setpoint is a valid command and must not become a PDOFilter `StaleInput` safety violation or engage limiting by itself; no-change tracking may only support short prediction windows and velocity timing. Guarded by `tests/test_pdofilter_velocity_continuity.cpp` and validated with focused CTest, `build_incremental-Crash.ps1 -NonInteractive`, and Smoke Test (16/16 passed).
- 2026-05-09 verified: when 0x603F communication-failure monitoring later reads cleanly, or a Fault Reset release succeeds and 0x603F refresh finds no fault, MainWindow must clear the EtherCAT alert latch/sound (`NotifyEthercatError(false)`) in addition to clearing master global error/filter state; otherwise `[ERROR] EtherCAT error active` can remain audible after recovery. Validated with `build_incremental-Crash.ps1 -NonInteractive` and Smoke Test (16/16 passed).
- 2026-05-17 verified: `MainWindow::NotifyEthercatError(true)` must include a concise operator-facing reason in the alert log, built from existing UI-side cached state such as 0x603F codes/read-failure counts, link/global-error thresholds, PDOFilter slave violation thresholds, or master global-error context. - 2026-05-09 verified: after an external 0x60FD emergency/immediate stop, AutoWindow/web Fault Reset must remain reachable instead of being disabled or rejected solely because the external stop input is still active. - 2026-05-09 verified: Immediate Stop / Emergency Stop controls are stop-class controls and must not inherit the normal motion-enable or fault-reset-only gates. - 2026-05-09 verified: PDOFilter hard-limit protection must treat both lower and upper limits as safety violations, and it must check the original incoming setpoint, the guarded command, and actual feedback position so input-anomaly substitution or CSV tracking-window clamps cannot hide an over-limit condition. - 2026-05-09 verified: VS Code CMake Tools/CTest integration for this workspace must use the root `CMakePresets.json` / `.vscode/settings.json` path with explicit VS18 BuildTools MSVC, Ninja, RC, and MT tool paths; stale Community kits or preset state can make the integration report `無法設定專案` before CTest discovery. Set the active kit to `Visual Studio Build Tools 2026 Release - amd64` after `cmake.resetState`. SOEM's `InstallRequiredSystemLibraries` warning for `Microsoft.VC143.CRT` is a CMake 4.1 + VS2026 redist-name mismatch and is suppressed at the top-level CMake entry before adding SOEM.
- 2026-05-09 verified: the main-window AutoWindow button must restore and resynchronize an existing minimized AutoWindow created by startup auto-run instead of destroying it; newly created AutoWindow instances should reset their action gate to disabled and then receive the owner-derived enable/disable state. This prevents the startup-auto path from requiring two clicks and reopening with stale disabled buttons.
- 2026-05-10 verified: built-in simulation axes now use a PID-like virtual servo plant in `EtherCATMaster::AdvanceSimulation()`, with position/velocity integrators, acceleration/velocity limits, damped CSP position following, CSV velocity following, quick-stop deceleration, and homing convergence before `0x6041` reports complete. Guarded by `tests/test_simulation_virtual_axis_pid_response.cpp` plus existing simulation CSV/Pose6D regressions; focused simulation CTest passed after the change.
- 2026-05-10 verified: simulation homing must ignore stale pre-start `0x1637` until a post-start non-complete state is observed, complete near the configured `0x607C` home offset before `MotionController::HomeAsync()`'s 3s timeout, and cancel/hold current position when homing bit4 is released. Homing-mode idle must not use stale `0x607A` as a CSP target, otherwise Auto DownToOrigin failures can make a virtual axis drift slowly back toward zero after timeout. Guarded by `tests/test_simulation_virtual_axis_pid_response.cpp` and focused simulation regression CTest.
- 2026-05-10 verified: simulation CSV velocity following must be acceleration-limited without integrator overshoot; the virtual velocity loop should not accumulate velocity-error integral because it can make `0x6064` oscillate around a stable PDOFilter output after soft-start. Constant-target simulation may snap to `0x607A` only after low velocity/error and a stable target-position window, so continuous inputs such as sine waves are not disturbed at turning points. Guarded by `tests/test_simulation_softstart_no_fatal_tracking.cpp`, `tests/test_simulation_filter_velocity_stability.cpp`, and focused simulation regression CTest.
- 2026-05-22 verified: post-soft-start CSV should publish smooth trajectory velocity (`PDOFilter::GetInternalVelocity()`) plus only a low-bandwidth, low-amplitude position bias. Do not feed high-frequency `0x606C` actual-velocity damping into `0x60FF` during normal moving feedforward segments; actual-velocity damping is limited to active soft-start and low-speed hold convergence so the drive's CSV velocity loop is not destabilized by delayed/noisy feedback. If actual feedback briefly leads the filtered target during normal moving feedforward, clear only same-direction correction/error state; do not hard-zero feedforward/command velocity unless the axis is in low-speed/hold lead-inhibit or a hard/protected-edge safety clamp. Guarded by tightened `tests/test_simulation_filter_velocity_stability.cpp` with moving-feedback-lead injection and validated with focused CSV/soft-start/PDOFilter tests plus Release smoke (25/25 passed).
- 2026-05-10 verified: applying the configured jerk limit (`iJerk_`) to PDOFilter normal online acceleration planning, or smoothing the non-soft-start overshoot brake with the same limit, badly distorted the Filter position output in real cyclic operation (visible large ringing/oscillation in the RT scope). Both paths must keep their original immediate behavior: normal online uses the existing stopping-distance/decel clamp directly, and overshoot braking subtracts a single full `iMaxDeceleration_` step. Do not reintroduce the `ApplyJerkLimit()` / overshoot-jerk smoothing path here without first reproducing on hardware/simulation that the Filter output stays clean.
- 2026-05-10 verified: PDOFilter global limiting must distinguish "limiting still forced by the master" from "this slave still has an active violation". When a globally force-limited slave's own velocity/accel violation clears, `GetCurrentViolationType()` must be allowed to return `None` even while `IsLimitingEnabled()` remains true; otherwise `EtherCATMaster::UpdateGlobalViolationState()` keeps seeing stale violations and can never auto-release the global limiting hold. Guarded by the global-forced recovery regression in `tests/test_pdofilter_velocity_continuity.cpp`.
- 2026-05-10 verified: `EtherCATMaster::UpdateGlobalViolationState()` should keep the global violation latch debounced, but it must release per-axis physical global limiting (`SetGlobalLimitingEnabled(false)`) as soon as no active violation remains. Holding reduced acceleration for the full debounce window can starve CSV tracking after local violations clear and cause a second wave of TrackingError. Global-only forced limiting may keep the softer envelope, but once that axis reports its own dynamic velocity/acceleration/deceleration violation it must restore configured deceleration (P5) so MMF slowdowns/reversals can brake the old direction. Validated with focused PDOFilter executables, `test_simulation_filter_velocity_stability`, and Release smoke 20/20.
- 2026-05-10 verified: PDOFilter dynamic velocity/accel violations must keep axes moving by capping `iMaxVelocity_` at the configured velocity-violation threshold, not at the soft-start crawl ratio (`SOFT_START_VEL_RATIO`). Soft-start and hard-limit behavior may still use the lower crawl speed, but non-fatal dynamic/global limiting should reduce acceleration while preserving configured deceleration and enough velocity for CSV tracking to continue and avoid false tracking-error stalls. Guarded by `tests/test_pdofilter_velocity_continuity.cpp` plus focused simulation/PDOFilter smoke tests.
- 2026-05-10 verified: when MMF input oscillates with large amplitude but stays within [iMinPDO_, iMaxPDO_], `PDOFilter::Filter()` keeps output strictly within the configured PDO envelope and does not exhibit growing-amplitude resonance. This invariant is now guarded across centred sine, off-centre sine that approaches the upper/lower PDO limit, and square-wave drives at multiple frequencies/servo lags by `tests/test_pdofilter_oscillating_input_within_limits.cpp`. The protection comes from two independent clamps in `Filter()`: the `effectiveSetpoint = clamp(target, iActValue - trackingErrorWindow, iActValue + trackingErrorWindow)` window plus the unconditional final `clamp(finalResult, iMinPDO_, iMaxPDO_)` (with the safety velocity bleed when the hard clamp engages); both must be preserved together to keep this contract.
- 2026-05-11 verified: `PDOFilter::Filter()` must rate-limit the tracking-error-window clamp result after the `iActValue +/- trackingErrorWindow` window is applied. The per-cycle step from `ioPrevFilteredOutput_` must stay within `max(abs(iConfiguredMaxVelocity_), abs(iMaxVelocity_)) * iCycleTime_`; otherwise the `GetFilteredOutput()` trace can jump by tens of degrees in one cycle and push `iActValue` past the hard PDO limit, triggering `AutoEmergencyStop`. Keep this rate limit between the tracking window clamp and the final hard `[iMinPDO_, iMaxPDO_]` clamp, skip it when `trackingErrorFatalTriggered` snaps output back to `iActValue`, and do not resync `oCurrentVelocity_`. Guarded by `tests/test_pdofilter_velocity_continuity.cpp` and `tests/test_pdofilter_pdo_limit_velocity_decay.cpp`; validated with focused PDOFilter CTest and full Release Smoke Test.
- 2026-05-11 verified (supersedes earlier same-day note): `PDOFilter::Filter()` final-output ordering is: (1) tracking-error window clamp, (2) hard PDO clamp with velocity bleed so `GetInternalVelocity()` stops feeding outward motion past the limit, (3) final acceleration limit on the committed position step, and (4) fatal-tracking recovery handling. The planning loop velocity ramp remains the source of inter-cycle continuity; the hard-limit bleed handles outward-velocity decay, and the acceleration limit only bounds per-cycle position movement. `tests/test_pdofilter_velocity_continuity.cpp` therefore checks gradual convergence rather than an instant one-cycle snap.
- 2026-05-11 verified (supersedes earlier 2026-05-11 entries): on non-fatal cycles, the final acceleration envelope remains the single source of truth for how far `finalResult` may move in one cycle. On fatal-tracking cycles, the safety target still clamps toward `iActValue` and the implementation then zeros velocity and acceleration so later cycles ramp from rest without injecting an RT-scope position jump. Guarded by `tests/test_pdofilter_velocity_continuity.cpp`, `tests/test_pdofilter_pdo_limit_velocity_decay.cpp`, `tests/test_simulation_softstart_no_fatal_tracking`, and `tests/test_simulation_multiturn_actual_position_normalized`; validated with focused PDOFilter CTest and Release Smoke Test.
- 2026-05-11 simulation virtual-mode actual-position teleports: `src/ethercat/EtherCATMaster.Simulation.cpp` contains explicit `axis.actualPositionCounts = target` teleports in three places: (a) homing completion when `closeEnough || maxActiveElapsed`, (b) CSV settle short-circuit when `targetDelta`, `targetVelocity`, `actualVelocity`, and `positionError` are all within the settle thresholds for `kSimulationCsvSettleStableSec`, and (c) the residual settle path in `stepPositionLoop` when the remaining error is negligible. The homing and CSV settle teleports are deliberate convergence shortcuts, but they also appear as `iActValue` discontinuities to `PDOFilter` and as visible RT-scope jumps in virtual mode. They do not occur on real EtherCAT slaves. Decision pending from user before changing or removing these teleports.
- 2026-05-12 verified (supersedes 2026-05-11 PDOFilter ordering notes): `PDOFilter::Filter()` delegates to `FilterWithInputState()`, and `FilterWithInputState()` is the implementation owner for CSV-safe filtering. It builds a bounded safety target before the final commit, applies a single acceleration/velocity envelope, then derives `oFilteredOutput_`, `oCurrentVelocity_`, and `oCurrentAcceleration_` from that same committed step so CSV `GetInternalVelocity()` stays coherent with the logical `0x607A` target. Held input with explicit zero measured velocity is a stopped hold, not prediction/stale input, and soft-start tracking guard notifications must not behave like fatal tracking countdowns. Guarded by `tests/test_pdofilter_violation_no_runaway.cpp`, `tests/test_pdofilter_velocity_continuity.cpp`, `tests/test_pdofilter_pdo_limit_velocity_decay.cpp`, `tests/test_pdofilter_random_sine_velocity_stability.cpp`, and `tests/test_pdofilter_oscillating_input_within_limits.cpp`; validated with focused executables, `build_incremental-Crash.ps1 -NonInteractive -AutoKill:$false`, and `Smoke Test` (22/22 passed).
- 2026-05-12 verified: CSV hard-limit/runaway protection must treat `PDOFilter`, `ComputeCsvVelocityCommand()`, staged outputs, IOmap visibility, and simulation as one closed-loop system. When the filter target or actual feedback is at/past a PDO hard limit, outward `0x60FF` feedforward/correction/command must be cleared immediately and the current IOmap `0x60FF` bytes refreshed, not only the next staged command. In simulation velocity mode, `0x607A` is the logical CSV target/safety target; the virtual plant must not continue applying stale outward `0x60FF` once actual crosses that target. Guarded by `tests/test_simulation_csv_hard_limit_no_outward_velocity.cpp`; validated by direct executable run and `Smoke Test` (22/22 passed).
- 2026-05-12 verified: CSV hard-limit outward checks in `EtherCATMaster.Cyclic.cpp` must compare mechanical-direction velocity (`csvVelocityCommand`) before PDO encoding, not raw `targetVelEncoded` sign, because axes with P2/invertSign enabled use the opposite raw sign for the same mechanical direction. Otherwise soft-start from a lower-limit/home-offset position can clear the inward `0x60FF` command for inverted axes 2/4/6 and leave them stationary. Guarded by `tests/test_simulation_inverted_axis_softstart_boundary.cpp`; validated with focused CTest and `Smoke Test` (23/23 passed).
- 2026-05-13 verified: PDOFilter configured limits and active limits are intentionally separate. `GetConfiguredMaxAcceleration()` / `GetConfiguredMaxDeceleration()` must report P4/P5 exactly as configured, while `GetMaxAcceleration()` / `GetMaxDeceleration()` are state-dependent and may be reduced by soft-start or limiting (typically to 20%). `iJerk_`/P6 is stored for API/config compatibility but is not an active jerk limiter in the current CSV-safe filtering path.
- 2026-05-13 verified: `docs/CSP_TO_CSV_FILTER_FLOW.md` is the project-owned reference for the current CSP-to-CSV tradeoff summary, PDOFilter action flow, stop-risk notes, and tunable/default parameter tables aligned to the actual implementation.
- 2026-05-13 verified: simulation-mode `EtherCATMaster::SimulationCyclicTask()` must wait for its virtual cycle deadline with an event/timer wait instead of a `Sleep(0)` short-tail loop, and must reset `nextWake` after missed Windows scheduling deadlines instead of running catch-up bursts. This keeps virtual mode from consuming one logical core and avoids delayed-load bursts that disturb simulated feedback/filter velocity. Validated with Release build, focused simulation/PDOFilter CTest, and `test_simulation_filter_velocity_stability.exe` CPU ratio about 0.63% (process CPU time / wall time).
- 2026-05-13 verified-by-source: RT scope `mmfInVel` should prefer the backend `mmfInVel` field from `/pdo_data` and `/pdo_sse`, sourced from `MMFReader::PollOnce()` per-axis QPC deltas on the EtherCAT-polled MMF snapshot, instead of browser-side SSE/epoch differencing. The browser keeps client-side differencing only as a fallback for older payloads. Validated with Release incremental build and adjacent simulation/MMF filter CTest; full smoke was blocked by `test_simulation_pose6d_softstart_completes` not reaching soft-start ready.
- 2026-05-13 verified: PDOFilter dynamic velocity/acceleration/deceleration warnings must be time-debounced before they are reported through `SetViolationCallback()` or promoted to global limiting. A single-cycle measured-velocity derivative spike may start the candidate timer but must not immediately set `GetCurrentViolationType()`, emit UI "加速度過大/減速度過大" logs, or force global limiting; hard-limit, stale/anomaly, and tracking-error safety paths remain independent. Guarded by the measured-velocity jitter regression in `tests/test_pdofilter_velocity_continuity.cpp`; focused PDOFilter executables and Release incremental build passed.
- 2026-05-15 verified: PDOFilter normal-online input smoothing uses bounded moving-average lead compensation to reduce filter-output phase lag without bypassing the final velocity/acceleration envelope. The compensated input must stay between the smoothed input and current MMF command, known held samples must keep the effective setpoint monotonic toward the held command, and overshoot braking should engage at 0.25 deg rather than allowing multi-degree target overshoot. Guarded by `tests/test_pdofilter_velocity_continuity.cpp` plus the adjacent PDOFilter/simulation stability suite.
- 2026-05-15 verified: PDOFilter dynamic velocity/acceleration violation tuning is loaded from executable-side `BigCat.ini` `[PDOFilter]` keys during `MainWindow::ApplySavedPdoFilterConfig()`, outside the PDO cycle. Defaults are `DynamicVelocityThresholdScale=0.60`, `DynamicAccelerationThresholdScale=1.20`, `DynamicVelocityViolationDelaySec=0.50`, and `DynamicAccelerationViolationDelaySec=0.20`; acceleration scale/delay also cover deceleration thresholds based on P5. Guarded by `tests/test_pdofilter_velocity_continuity.cpp`; validated with Release incremental build and smoke CTest.
- 2026-05-15 verified: `tests/test_simulation_pose6d_softstart_completes.cpp` uses a 15s ready deadline because the Windows virtual servo plant can legitimately take slightly over the old 8s boundary to settle under loaded smoke runs. - 2026-05-15 verified: MainWindow PDO violation callbacks suppress UI log chatter for dynamic velocity/acceleration/deceleration violations while per-axis limiting remains active. `PDOFilter::GetCurrentViolationType()` may still clear to `None` under global limiting so `EtherCATMaster::UpdateGlobalViolationState()` can release global limiting correctly, but the desktop UI should not print `違規解除 [限制仍啟用中]` or accel/decel flip-flop logs until limiting actually clears. - 2026-05-17 verified: PDOFilter soft-start hard-limit reporting is direction-aware when soft-start widened the active PDO limit to the starting actual position (for example P13/home offset outside P9/P10). - 2026-05-17 verified: `build_incremental-Crash.ps1` AutoKill also treats `ctest.exe` and `run_smoke_tests.ps1` PowerShell processes that reference the active build tree as build-lock owners, then retries the build once after a nonzero build exit when AutoKill is enabled.
